 **Software Engineer**

* Jobvite for recruiting and applicant tracking

* Serving as the primary engineering resource for Trustwell Living, taking projects end to end – from business problem to deployed, production solution

* Developing the reporting and dashboards that support day\-to\-day operations and portfolio decisions

* Evolving our data models and warehouse architecture
* Data quality frameworks and automated QC processes
* Deployment, CI/CD, and monitoring that keep our systems running reliably

* Strong Python skills across data engineering, backend services, and APIs
* Hands\-on experience building data pipelines and transformations (Airflow, dbt, or similar)
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred) and SQL
* Experience working directly with non\-technical stakeholders

* DevOps experience – Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and AWS
* Front\-end development with React
* Git and CI/CD practices

* Excellent communication – a good listener asks insight\-generating questions
